---
title: "Lung cancer in Ohio, 1968--1988"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: cosmo
    source_code: embed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(tigris)
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# data: one row per county and year
oh <- read_csv("data/ohio_lung_cancer_1968_1988.csv",
               col_types = cols(GEOID = "c"))          # GEOID as text

# boundaries
oh_map <- counties(state = "OH", cb = TRUE, year = 2020,
                   progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326)                             # leaflet wants lon/lat

# for the map: one row per county
by_county <- oh |>
  group_by(GEOID) |>
  summarise(Y = sum(Y), E = sum(E), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(SIR = Y / E)

oh_map <- left_join(oh_map, by_county, by = "GEOID")

# for the time series: one row per year
focus <- "Cuyahoga"                              # county to follow

by_year <- bind_rows(
  oh |> group_by(year) |>
    summarise(Y = sum(Y), E = sum(E), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(area = "Ohio"),
  oh |> filter(county == focus) |>
    mutate(area = focus)
) |>
  mutate(SIR = Y / E)
```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Standardized incidence ratio (SIR) by county, 1968--1988

```{r map}
breaks <- c(0, 0.5, 2/3, 0.9, 1/0.9, 1.5, 2, Inf)  # Exercise 4 classes
pal <- colorBin(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdBu")),
                domain = oh_map$SIR, bins = breaks)

leaflet(oh_map) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(SIR), fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "white", weight = 1,
    label = ~sprintf("%s: SIR %.2f (%.0f observed, %.0f expected)",
                     NAME, SIR, Y, E),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "black",
                                        bringToFront = TRUE)
  ) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~SIR, title = "SIR",
            labFormat = labelFormat(digits = 2), opacity = 0.8)
```

> SIR = observed / expected. Red: more cases than expected; blue: fewer.

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### SIR by year (dashed line: as many cases as expected)

```{r timeseries}
cols <- setNames(c("black", "#B2182B"), c("Ohio", focus))

p <- ggplot(by_year, aes(year, SIR, colour = area)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "SIR", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)                                  # hover, zoom
```

### Counties

```{r table}
oh_map |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  transmute(County = NAME, Observed = Y,
            Expected = round(E, 1), SIR = round(SIR, 2)) |>
  arrange(desc(SIR)) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10))
```

> Data: Moraga (2019), Ch. 7. Boundaries: US Census Bureau, via `tigris`.
